learning_objective: 🎯 Discover how mass media, storytelling, and journalism are used not just for news, but as powerful tools to eradicate poverty, spread health awareness, and develop society!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: It is the use of communication to facilitate social development. Instead of just selling products or entertaining, it aims to educate people about health, farming, education, and rights to improve their lives.
Development journalism focuses on the success stories and struggles of marginalized communities, holding governments accountable for development promises rather than just reporting crime or politics.

Different tools reach different people. Print media (newspapers) needs literacy. Radio is excellent for remote/rural areas. Street plays (Nukkad Natak) and folk songs are highly effective for engaging local communities emotionally.
A campaign is a planned set of communication activities designed to achieve a specific goal (e.g., 'Pulse Polio' or 'Swachh Bharat'). Advocacy involves speaking up to influence policy changes.
A development communicator needs empathy, an understanding of the local culture and language, good writing/speaking skills, and the ability to simplify complex technical information.

fun_activity.title: 📝 The 'Save Water' Slogan
fun_activity.instructions: Imagine you are a development journalist tasked with getting people in your city to stop wasting water. Write a catchy 1-line slogan and draw a quick sketch of what your billboard poster would look like!

exam_tips: 📌 Clearly define the difference between regular journalism (reporting facts) and development journalism (reporting to drive social change).
📌 Emphasize the role of Community Radio in reaching rural audiences where TV and internet might not be available.
📌 Remember that effective communication must be two-way (listening to the community), not just top-down.
quick_recap: ⭐ The primary goal of DevComm is social change and empowerment.
⭐ Traditional media (folk dances, puppetry) is still highly effective for rural communication.
⭐ 'Swachh Bharat Abhiyan' is a massive real-world example of a development communication campaign.
